简介: Victoria Pedretti (born March 23, 1995) is an American actress best known for her role as Eleanor "Nell" Crain in the Netflix horror series The Haunting of Hill House[3] and Love Quinn in the Netflix thriller series You.[4] In 2019, she portrayed Lulu in Quentin Tarantino's film Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.[5]
